title: Listen to the “Yellowjackets” Cast Event on SiriusXM
summary: The cast of 'Yellowjackets,' Melanie Lynskey, Sammi Hanratty, Jasmin Savoy Brown, and Liv Hewson talked the final season of the Showtime series.
body_markdown:
The cast of *Yellowjackets* , Melanie Lynskey, Sammi Hanratty, Jasmin Savoy Brown, and Liv Hewson will be in the SiriusXM New York Studios for a special cast event hosted by the Morning Mash Up’s Nicole Ryan and Ryan Sampson.


[Yellowjackets Cast Event Premieres Friday, November 20 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogYellowjacketsCastEvent)


## *Yellowjackets* Cast Event


Melanie Lynskey, Sammi Hanratty, Jasmin Savoy Brown, and Liv Hewson share the secrets behind some of the series most shocking moments and talk ending the series with the upcoming fourth season.


Listen to the full interview on SiriusXM Hits 1 on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogYellowjacketsCastEvent) starting Friday, November 20 at 9am ET.


The fourth and final season of *Yellowjackets* premieres on Paramount+ November 20.
